existing: Without remote monitoring, a water surface cleaning boat depends on manual checks, so problems are found late and nothing is recorded.
proposed: An ESP32 reads HC-SR04 ultrasonic and NEO-6M GPS, decides on the board and drives Thrusters and Collection motor. It splits sensing, control and communication into FreeRTOS tasks for deterministic timing. Readings and alerts reach the user in real time.
advantages: Safe to demonstrate in a lab
